userStories.title: Upgrade SRS algorithm to adaptive doubling intervals
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to replace the fixed 3-bucket SRS (1/4/14 days) with adaptive doubling intervals so revision scheduling better matches the forgetting curve.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/srs.ts: calculateNextRevisionDate function signature updated to accept (score: number, currentIntervalStep: number) with currentIntervalStep defaulting to 0 for backward compatibility
Interval sequence defined as constant array: [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256]
Score 1-2 (struggled): reset interval_step to 0, schedule +1 day
Score 3 (acceptable): keep same interval_step, schedule same interval from sequence
Score 4-5 (strong): advance interval_step by 1 (capped at max index 8), schedule next interval from sequence
Returns updated SRSResult including interval_step field
Existing callers still work with single argument (backward compatible due to default parameter)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: The adaptive doubling is research-backed. Sequence: 1→2→4→8→16→32→64→128→256 days.

userStories.title: Update submissions API to use adaptive SRS and interval_step

acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/submissions: before calculating SRS, queries the latest previous submission for this user+problem to get current interval_step (defaults to 0 if no previous submission)
POST /api/submissions: passes interval_step to calculateNextRevisionDate, saves returned interval_step to the new submission record
POST /api/submissions: includes interval_step in the INSERT fields to user_progress
PATCH /api/submissions: reads the submission's current interval_step, passes it to calculateNextRevisionDate with the new score, updates both performance_score, next_revision_date, and interval_step
GET /api/submissions: includes interval_step in the SELECT fields
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Backward compatible: existing submissions with interval_step=0 (the default) will work correctly with the new algorithm.

userStories.title: Build daily plan generation engine
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a plan generation function that creates a personalized daily mix of revision + new problems based on user preferences, pattern progression, and weakness data.
acceptanceCriteria: New file src/lib/daily-plan.ts created
Exports async function generateDailyPlan(userId: string, supabase: SupabaseClient): Promise<PlanItem[]>
Reads user preferences from profiles table: questions_per_day, proficiency_level, problem_set, current_pattern_index
Revision items: queries user_progress for problems where next_revision_date <= now(), ordered by performance_score ASC (hardest first), limited to floor(questions_per_day * 0.7) items
New items: fills remaining quota (minimum ceil(questions_per_day * 0.3)) with unsolved problems
New problems selected from problems table using pattern_order column, starting from the user's current pattern category
Within current pattern: Easy problems first, then Medium, then Hard
Difficulty distribution target based on proficiency_level: beginner (50E/40M/10H), rusty (40E/45M/15H), intermediate (20E/60M/20H), advanced (10E/40M/50H)
Skips problems user has already solved (exists in user_progress for this user)
Weak pattern boost: if a pattern has avg score < 3 in user_pattern_confidence or user_progress, insert 1 extra problem from that pattern if quota allows
Estimated minutes per item: Easy=15, Medium=25, Hard=40
If current pattern exhausted (no more unsolved problems), picks from next pattern
Returns empty new items array only if ALL problems in selected problem_set are solved
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This is a pure server-side function. It queries multiple tables but should complete in <500ms. The difficulty distribution is a target ratio — if not enough Easy problems exist in current pattern, fill with Medium.
